steps: If installed alongside Everything by VoidTools, it breaks thumbnails and makes them impossible if not slow to load.
My theory is somewhere there's a hangup between VoidTools, PowerToys and FileExplorer.
Initially I thought my version of Windows 11 broke.
I had tried DiskCleanup in windows to delete the thumbnails to see if that brought them back, that didn't work.

Running CMD sfc /scannow, DISM.exe /Online /Cleanup-image /Scanhealth, DISM.exe /Online /Cleanup-image /Restorehealth and DISM.exe /online /cleanup-image /startcomponentcleanup as administrator resulted in no change.
reproduce.expected_result: I wasn't expecting for VoidTools Everything search and PowerToys to conflict. What I expected was to use all features without any noticeable slowdown, on the previous instance of Windows 11 and this custom reinstall.

title: File Explorer and Thumbnails stop working
author: Honkai-Khronos
summary: The File Explorer: Thumbnail preview report describes thumbnails break and File explorer slows down to a crawl, becoming unusable. Through VoidTools Everything, the issue happened as soon after adding new drives and millions of files for the program to search through.

proposed_fixes.title: Isolate or time-bound failed PDF thumbnail generation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A problematic PDF can keep the PowerToys thumbnail provider busy long enough to block subsequent Explorer thumbnail generation and degrade Explorer responsiveness.
plan: Trace PDF thumbnail generation and cancellation boundaries in the File Explorer add-on.
Add a bounded timeout or failure isolation so one document cannot stall the provider pipeline.
Log the skipped file safely and allow later thumbnail requests to continue.
verification: Place a known slow or malformed PDF before normal PDF and image files, rebuild the thumbnail cache, and confirm Explorer remains responsive and later thumbnails still generate.

confidence.rationale: Two reporters independently isolate PDF thumbnail generation and a specific problematic file, but the exact blocking call and safe cancellation mechanism need confirmation.
